rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for ordinary, inclusive, institutional, generic, caregiver, modesty, and procedural uses of “we.”

example.english: We’ll have lunch together today, then go back to the office.
example.traditional: 我哋今日一齊食飯，之後再返公司。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 zi1 hau6 zoi3 faan1 gung1 si1

rows.note: Use this when addressing everyone present, especially where English says “we all” or “everyone.”

example.english: Everyone, take your seats—we’re about to start the meeting.
example.traditional: 大家快啲入座，我哋就嚟開會喇。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 faai3 di1 jap6 zo6 ngo5 dei6 zau6 lai4 hoi1 wui2 laa3

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal written institutional or explanatory language rather than ordinary Hong Kong speech.

example.english: We will announce the results next week.
example.traditional: 我們會在下星期公布結果。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mun4 wui5 zoi6 haa6 sing1 kei4 gung1 bou3 git3 gwo2
